entries.guide/balatro-boss-blinds:
# Apply the revealed Boss to this build

Read the Boss catalog (read_rules key: guide/balatro-boss-blinds/bosses) for effects, then evaluate how the revealed Boss interacts with the current build.

Identify the dependencies the Boss changes: hand family, faces, suit, first scoring card, held cards, discards, hand size, one Joker, order or cash. Evaluate favorable interactions too: a largely independent-Joker engine can be comparatively resilient to card debuffs, leaving an opportunity to invest.

Recompute the actual score/resources under the effect. A debuffed Flush can still outperform an off-suit fallback through hand base and independent Jokers. A playable hand can score zero under a Boss restriction. Do not estimate viability as best-hand score times remaining hands without considering draw reliability and restrictions.

Compare available counters: altered card selection, leveled fallback, consumable, sellable spare, affordable reroll or correctly timed disable. A Luchador that might appear later is an uncertain acquisition, not an available counter. Shops before the Boss have value when they can repair the interaction.

Selling Luchador before entering the Boss does not execute its in-Boss disable. Eternal can invalidate a Verdant Leaf sale plan. Amber Acorn invalidates assumed positions; only public observations or lawful continuity can restore identity. Crimson Heart's disabled Joker must be reassessed after a hand, not assumed to change on discard.

Under The Eye, reserve useful distinct categories for later hands. Under The Mouth, commit to a repeatable sufficient category. Under The Needle/Water, inspect post-selection counters for modifiers. Under The Serpent, compare the three-card refill with the score and retained-hand effects of the proposed selection.

Choose the supported counter or best available survival attempt. Optional notes can identify the dependency, timing and uncertainty.
entries.guide/balatro-boss-blinds/bosses:
# Boss effect catalog

Use the observed Boss effect, target and active/disabled state. For counterplay, read the Boss decision skill (read_rules key: guide/balatro-boss-blinds).

| Boss | Baseline effect |
| --- | --- |
| The Hook | After play, 2 random held cards discarded |
| The Ox | Playing the named hand sets cash to $0 |
| The House | Initial hand face down |
| The Wall | Target ×4 base instead of usual ×2 |
| The Wheel | Drawn cards have 1-in-7 face-down chance |
| The Arm | Played hand loses one level before scoring, minimum level 1 |
| The Club | Clubs debuffed |
| The Fish | Cards drawn after a play face down |
| The Psychic | Requires five played cards; five scoring cards not required |
| The Goad | Spades debuffed |
| The Water | Removes starting discards |
| The Window | Diamonds debuffed |
| The Manacle | −1 hand size |
| The Eye | A hand type cannot repeat within this round |
| The Mouth | First played hand type constrains later scoring hands |
| The Plant | Face cards debuffed |
| The Serpent | Three-card refill after play/discard instead of ordinary hand-size refill |
| The Pillar | Cards played earlier this Ante debuffed |
| The Needle | Normally one hand; target ×1 base |
| The Head | Hearts debuffed |
| The Tooth | Lose $1 per played card; debt possible |
| The Flint | Hand base Chips and Mult halved |
| The Mark | Face cards drawn face down |
| Amber Acorn | Jokers concealed and shuffled; effects persist |
| Verdant Leaf | Playing cards debuffed until Joker sale |
| Violet Vessel | Target ×6 base |
| Crimson Heart | One Joker disabled; changes after hands |
| Cerulean Bell | One held card forced selected for actions |

Normal Boss multiplier is ×2. Showdowns occur every eighth Ante. Do not infer the next Boss from a presumed repetition cycle. Cerulean reselection timing, Serpent capacity edges and Flint rounding are covered in known limits (read_rules key: guide/limits).

A debuffed card can still classify a hand but normally loses scoring, held and discard effects; “triggers nothing” is too broad for every whole-hand or played-set check. Wild's active all-suit membership exposes it to all suit Bosses; while debuffed its all-suit behavior is removed. Stone's rank/suit/debuff edge cases require actual build evidence.

Face-down means unknown, not inactive. A discard does not universally guarantee a visible replacement: Wheel/Mark/Fish/House or other active effects can change visibility. Retaining prior identity requires publicly valid continuity; an opaque ID is not hidden rank/suit data. Boss effects normally end with the round, but their consequences—Arm levels, Ox/Tooth money, for example—can persist.

| Counter mechanism | Effect and timing |
| --- | --- |
| Director's Cut | $10 Boss reroll once per Ante, when legal |
| Retcon | Additional $10 Boss rerolls, when legal |
| Boss Tag | Boss reroll on tag resolution |
| Luchador | Sell during the active Boss to disable its effect |
| Chicot | Disables Boss effects |

After a Boss reroll or disable, inspect the actual effect and target. Target changes for Wall, Violet Vessel and Needle are not specified exactly here. Start-of-Blind resource effects such as Burglar can alter Needle's normal one-hand result; use the resulting counters.

References: [Blinds and Antes](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Blinds_and_Antes), [Burglar](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Burglar), [Jokers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Jokers), [Vouchers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Vouchers).
entries.guide/balatro-consumables:
# Use the consumable in its actual context

Load the catalog (read_rules key: guide/balatro-consumables/catalog) for a named effect and modifiers (read_rules key: guide/balatro-deck-building/modifiers) for enhancement/seal layers.

Read the supported phase, target count, physical positions, available temporary/round hand, capacity and effect text. “Up to two” and “exactly two” differ. For Death, verify the overwrite card is physically left of the copied card. Use only available targets; a known full-deck card is not automatically targetable.

Use a Planet before its intended scoring benefit; with Observatory compare a permanent level against the value of holding it. Concentrate levels when the hand is repeatable, and keep a useful fallback when the Boss or deck warrants one. Compare the improvement with its cost and the next Blind's needs.

Evaluate money effects at use time and generators at resolution capacity. Leave space for useful Blue/Purple generation when doing so helps. The winning hand may determine Blue Seal's Planet; it need not be the most-played hand.

Seals and transformations serve different roles: played scorer, held support or discarded generator. Compare a copied strong card with the lost rank coverage or held value. Sigil is random and can harm a suit engine; Immolate can destroy key cards; Wraith spends all cash; Ankh/Hex require checking possible survivors; Ectoplasm/Ouija cost hand size. “Spectral” and “safe upgrade” are not interchangeable.

After buying a pack, evaluate the revealed choices; its cost is sunk. Taking nothing can be correct. For multi-pick packs, apply one choice and re-observe before choosing the next. Normal pack consumables are used immediately; Standard cards join the deck and Buffoon Jokers enter inventory. Follow an observed exception when present.
entries.guide/balatro-consumables/catalog:
# Consumable effects and target counts

This catalog covers 22 Tarots, 12 Planets and 18 Spectrals. Match the current effect, legal target count, hand and capacity before use.

Consumables normally use two inventory slots before modifiers. Targeted cards must exist in the current legal hand, such as a round hand or Arcana/Spectral temporary hand. A usable phase is determined by the host, not “any time in control.” Normal pack consumables are immediately used; generated cards may enter inventory. Generation depends on capacity at resolution, including whether using the source frees room. Negative consumables have capacity effects; do not infer them solely from a card name.

## Tarots

| Strength | Raise rank by one, including K→A and A→2 | Up to 2 |
| The Hanged Man | Destroy | Up to 2 |
| Death | Left selected card becomes copy of right selected card, including modifier layers | Exactly 2; physical order |

“Up to” does not prove that zero selection is legal. A fixed/exact count is not interchangeable with an upper limit. New enhancements replace the previous enhancement; editions and seals are separate layers. Eligibility and copy fidelity for unusual dynamic card bonuses remain build-dependent.

## Planets

The canonical 12-name mapping and level increments live in hand values (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/hand-values), avoiding a second table: Pluto/High Card, Mercury/Pair, Uranus/Two Pair, Venus/Three of a Kind, Saturn/Straight, Jupiter/Flush, Earth/Full House, Mars/Four of a Kind, Neptune/Straight Flush, Planet X/Five of a Kind, Ceres/Flush House, Eris/Flush Five. A Planet raises its associated hand one level. Secret-hand Planet eligibility follows first play; Black Hole can level unrevealed hands.

entries.guide/balatro-core-rules:
# Core mechanics

Use actual public counters and active effects over the defaults below. See known limits (read_rules key: guide/limits) for specific timing and interaction uncertainties.

- A run contains Antes; an Ante normally contains Small, Big, then Boss Blind. A round is one played Blind. Clear the Ante-8 Boss to win the ordinary run; endless continuation is a separate objective.
- Accumulated score must reach the current target. Overkill does not carry forward. Exhausting viable resources normally ends the run, subject to an actual rescue effect.
- Base resources: 4 hands, 3 discards, hand size 8, $4, 5 Joker slots, 2 consumable slots. Red Deck adds a discard. Hand size and hands remaining are different quantities.
- A normal play/discard selects 1–5 held cards. A play consumes one hand; a discard consumes one discard action. Played kickers are not discarded cards. A Boss may permit submission yet award no score.
- Normal refills draw toward hand size; insufficient draw-pile cards produce a smaller refill. Used cards do not reshuffle mid-round. Start a new round with the surviving modified deck, subject to active effects.
- Small and Big may be skipped for their displayed tags. Bosses cannot ordinarily be skipped. A skip forgoes the played round and its normal cash-out/shop; a tag can grant a separate reward.
- A cleared Blind leads through settlement to a shop. Packs are modal selections; observe the actual return phase, including packs opened by tags outside shops.
- Default Blind rewards: Small $3, Big $4, regular Boss $5, Showdown $8. Red+ removes only the Small Blind's base reward. Ordinary unused hands pay $1 each; discards have no default payout.
- Interest is ordinarily $1 per full $5 of eligible cash, capped at $5. Settlement timing and special income need the actual engine ordering; see shop rules (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/shop).

J/Q/K are faces; Ace is not. Numbered cards are 2–10. “Scoring” is a subset of played cards; “held” means cards left in hand during resolution. Chips and Mult are scoring accumulators; money is a purchase resource. Hand levels persist separately from poker-hand precedence. A debuff and a concealed identity are different states.

Read hand recognition and scoring (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/mechanics) for classification, decks/stakes (read_rules key: guide/balatro-decks-stakes/decks-stakes) for target tables and modifiers, and tags (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/tags) for skip rewards. No complete score preview is assumed.
entries.guide/balatro-deck-building:
# Shape the deck around useful roles

Read modifier mechanics (read_rules key: guide/balatro-deck-building/modifiers) for a relevant layer or trigger.

Distinguish full deck, current public remaining multiset, held cards and used cards; keep duplicate identities separate. Assess each card as a played scorer, held asset and discard asset. Decoration alone does not make it useful.

An edit should improve achievable score, reliability or resources while covering the next Blind. Copies and transformations can concentrate strong properties; removing irrelevant cards raises density. Added cards also consume future draws. There is no universal minimum deck size: compare actual expected cycling with available cards.

For Straights, preserve rank windows; removing faces or Aces indiscriminately can create gaps. For repeated ranks, strengthen the supported rank and useful modifier bundle. For Flushes, consider suit density and the revealed suit counter. Small-hand engines may prefer held Steel/Gold/Blue support to another large-hand pattern.

Account for a new higher-precedence hand routing onto a weaker level, enhancement replacement, Glass destruction, random removal, and pre-scoring effects such as Vampire removing an enhancement. A Wild card broadens suit membership and Boss exposure, not rank membership.

After each edit refresh the public counts, legal targets and scoring assumptions. Decline an off-plan Standard Pack card when dilution outweighs its value; the purchase does not obligate a pick.
entries.guide/balatro-deck-building/modifiers:
# Card modifiers

A playing card has at most one enhancement, one edition and one seal. Replacing one layer removes its previous modifier while preserving the other layers unless the effect says otherwise.

| Enhancement | Baseline effect |
| --- | --- |
| Bonus | +30 Chips when scored |
| Mult | +4 Mult when scored |
| Wild | Every suit, no rank substitution; suit Bosses can debuff it |
| Glass | ×2 Mult when scored; 1-in-4 destruction chance after scoring |
| Steel | ×1.5 Mult while held during scoring |
| Stone | 50 Chips; no active rank/suit; additional scoring card when played |
| Gold | $3 when held at round end |
| Lucky | Separate 1-in-5 chance for +20 Mult and 1-in-15 for $20 when scored |

| Edition | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Foil | +50 Chips |
| Holographic | +10 Mult |
| Polychrome | ×1.5 Mult |
| Negative | Additional capacity for its owned Joker/consumable type; not an ordinary base-game playing-card edition |

| Seal | Trigger |
| --- | --- |
| Gold | $3 when scored |
| Red | One extra eligible card activation, including supported held effects |
| Blue | When held at round end, creates Planet for the final played hand if capacity permits |
| Purple | When discarded, creates random Tarot if capacity permits |

Debuffs suppress ordinary card effects and can preserve classification. A debuffed Wild loses all-suit behavior; the exact rank/suit behavior of debuffed Stone and uncommon modifier hooks requires matching-build verification. Negative capacity is an exception to ordinary debuff suppression. Sticker mechanics belong in decks/stakes (read_rules key: guide/balatro-decks-stakes/decks-stakes).

Red repeats eligible effects, not a new whole hand. Glass destruction occurs after scoring; do not count a new independent destruction roll for each retrigger without matching evidence. Oops! All 6s modifies listed probabilities; use the actual effect rather than treating every random process as doubled.

References: [Card Modifiers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Card_Modifiers), [developer 1.0.1f patch notes, SteamDB mirror](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/14234225/).
entries.guide/balatro-decks-stakes:
# Read the actual modifiers

Read the deck/stake reference (read_rules key: guide/balatro-decks-stakes/decks-stakes) for starting modifiers and cumulative difficulty changes.

Record observed cards, resources, cash, capacity, vouchers/consumables and final scoring rule. Accumulate stake effects; then account for actual Boss, Joker and challenge changes. A deck name is not proof of the current hand count.

Green removes the ordinary interest incentive, not cash's other value. Painted raises hand-size flexibility but slot competition. Black's extra Joker slot has an immediate hand-resource cost. Abandoned and Checkered change the available opening patterns; neither proves a hand is automatic. Anaglyph creates tag opportunities, not a required skip schedule.

Plasma rewards the effective sum entering its balancing formula; a lower-component purchase is not automatically better. Compare actual gain, including multiplication and rounding, rather than trying to equalize components before balancing.

At higher stakes, include all earlier restrictions. Judge Eternal commitment, Perishable expiry and Rental payments against the actual expected holding horizon. Do not import older Orange pack-price or Gold hand-size penalties into this 1.0.1 rules baseline. Unknown challenge/mod changes require matching effect data.
entries.guide/balatro-decks-stakes/decks-stakes:

Starting modifiers combine with cumulative stakes and active Joker, voucher, Boss or challenge effects. Use the resulting public values.

| Deck | Starting modifier |

| Red | +1 discard per round |
| Blue | +1 hand per round |
| Yellow | +$10 starting cash, ordinarily $14 total |
| Green | No interest; $2 per unused hand and $1 per unused discard |
| Black | +1 Joker slot; −1 hand per round |
| Magic | Crystal Ball and two Fools |
| Nebula | Telescope; −1 consumable slot |
| Ghost | Hex; Spectrals may appear as shop offers |
| Abandoned | 40 cards, no J/Q/K |
| Checkered | 26 Spades and 26 Hearts |
| Zodiac | Tarot Merchant, Planet Merchant, Overstock |
| Painted | +2 hand size; −1 Joker slot |
| Anaglyph | Double Tag after each Boss defeated |
| Plasma | Balance Chips/Mult before scoring; doubled base Blind sizes; exact rounding unresolved |
| Erratic | Randomized starting ranks/suits; inspect actual public multiset |

| Stake | Added constraint; earlier stakes also apply |
| --- | --- |
| White | Baseline |
| Red | Small Blind base reward removed |
| Green | Faster target scaling |
| Black | Eternal shop Jokers possible |
| Blue | −1 discard per round |
| Purple | Further target scaling |
| Orange | Perishable shop Jokers possible |
| Gold | Rental shop Jokers possible |

Orange and Gold use Perishable and Rental rules in this baseline. Read sticker eligibility and actual unlock/challenge restrictions from the current game.

Challenges add a separate layer: actual deck composition, starting items, banned content, capacities, money/scoring rules and resource limits. Profile unlock availability is not enumerated. An unlock objective differs from a run-win objective; neither pack is a complete challenge/mod catalog.

Eternal prevents ordinary sale/destruction. Perishable normally debuffs after five productive rounds; read actual remaining counters and debuffs. Rental normally has $1 acquisition price and charges $3 per round, potentially producing debt. Stickers can combine where allowed; do not assume every combination is legal. A debuffed Perishable can remain sellable and retain Negative capacity. Negative capacity disappears when that owned object is removed. Precise timer pauses, stacking eligibility and settlement order remain unresolved.

## Target tables as orientation

| Ante | White–Red base |
| --- | ---: |
| 1 | 300 |
| 2 | 800 |
| 3 | 2000 |
| 4 | 5000 |
| 5 | 11000 |
| 6 | 20000 |
| 7 | 35000 |
| 8 | 50000 |

Use displayed targets for actions, especially at Green+ stakes. Small normally uses base; Big ×1.5; Boss ×2; Wall ×4, Needle ×1, Violet Vessel ×6; Plasma doubles the deck baseline. Ante-reduction and other active modifiers can change the target.

References: [Decks](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Decks), [Stakes](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Stakes), [Plasma Deck](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Plasma_Deck), [developer patch mirror](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/14234225/).
entries.guide/balatro-economy-shop:
# Spend for the actual bottleneck

Read shop and vouchers (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/shop) for stock, prices and effects, or the tag catalog (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/tags) for a skip reward.

Read visible prices, sell values, slots, cash-dependent score, liabilities, next Blind and revealed Boss. Compare visible offers against the current bottleneck: Chips, early Mult, multiplication, consistency, growth, money, capacity or a specific Boss interaction. Buy enough strength to survive, then invest when the expected opportunity remains useful.

The $25 interest target is conditional. A purchase below it can save the run or earn back income by clearing earlier. Its future interest cost lasts only while the balance remains below the relevant threshold; it is not automatically a permanent $1-per-round loss. Green Deck has no base interest but still values cash for purchases and effects.

For a sale, evaluate the remaining build, copy targets, cash-linked score and Negative capacity before assuming the replacement works. Rental costs accumulate over rounds held; Perishable value has an expiry; Eternal may make a proposed sale impossible. An economy Joker can stay useful above $25, and flat scoring can stay useful late.

Reroll with a target class and a purchase budget after the fee. A visible usable upgrade can beat a speculative ideal. Compare vouchers with remaining opportunities: hand/hand-size upgrades affect reliability; interest upgrades require cash; Boss control needs its fee; Ante reduction also removes a resource. There is no universal voucher or pack priority list.

For a skip, compare the displayed tag's timing with forgone income, shop access, triggers and scaling, and with the next Blind's safety. Price a rarity/edition tag against the shop and income forgone. Save Anaglyph Double Tags for opportunities that justify that cost. A Boss Tag can justify skipping when it directly addresses a threat.

Make one purchase/sale/reroll/skip/exit action, then re-observe before dependent choices.
entries.guide/balatro-economy-shop/shop:
# Shop, settlement, packs and vouchers

Use the current offers, prices, capacity and effect text when modifiers change these defaults.

## Stock and prices

A default shop has two individual offers, two packs and an Ante voucher. Rerolls replace individual offers, not packs/voucher. A new shop restocks packs; ordinary voucher stock changes with Ante. The first shop includes a normal Buffoon Pack in this rules baseline.

| Item | Imported base price |
| --- | --- |
| Tarot / Planet | $3 |
| Spectral | $4 |
| Playing card | $1 |
| Normal / Jumbo / Mega pack | $4 / $6 / $8 |
| Voucher | $10 |
| Joker | Individual card price; rarity alone does not determine it |

Typical edition surcharges are Foil +$2, Holographic +$3, Polychrome/Negative +$5. Sell value is normally half the relevant cost, floored, minimum $1, subject to Rental and value-changing effects. Use displayed buy/sell prices when discounts or other modifiers apply.

Rerolls normally start at $5 and increase by $1 in the same shop; Reroll Surplus reduces the base to $3, Reroll Glut to $1. D6 makes the next shop's starting reroll cost $0; free-reroll effects such as Chaos the Clown have their own handling. Inspect the next displayed price rather than inferring all interactions.

Owned Jokers and held consumables are normally excluded from duplicate shop offers; Showman permits duplicates. Special creation, tags and copy effects can have different eligibility.

## Interest and settlement

Ordinary interest planning formula: `min(cap, floor(max(0, eligible_cash)/5))`, baseline cap $5. Seed Money raises the cap to $10 and Money Tree to $20. Green Deck has no base interest; its unused-resource payout is $2 per hand and $1 per discard.

Interest depends on the eligible balance at settlement. The exact ordering of Gold, Rental, Joker income and cash-out awards is a known limit (read_rules key: guide/limits). Do not include unreceived money in an exact interest forecast unless the relevant ordering is established.

## Packs

| Family | Normal choices | Jumbo choices | Mega choices | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard | 3, take 1 | 5, take 1 | 5, take 2 | Playing cards join deck |
| Arcana | 3, use 1 | 5, use 1 | 5, use 2 | Tarot use with temporary hand |
| Celestial | 3, use 1 | 5, use 1 | 5, use 2 | Planet use |
| Buffoon | 2, take 1 | 4, take 1 | 4, take 2 | Jokers, subject to capacity |
| Spectral | 2, use 1 | 4, use 1 | 4, use 2 | Spectral use with temporary hand |

Normal pack consumables are immediately used; generated consumables may enter slots. This does not mean all pack cards are consumed. Arcana/Spectral expose an actual temporary hand for supported targeting. Pack choice count and current legal options outrank the table. A pack can be skipped after opening. Packs from skip tags can open outside a shop.

## Voucher pairs

Upgraded vouchers require their prerequisite in the run, subject to actual unlocks and overrides.

| Overstock | +1 shop card slot | Overstock Plus | +1 further slot |

entries.guide/balatro-economy-shop/tags:
# Tags and skip timing

Read the visible tag, target and resolution state. Tags may resolve immediately or wait for a later event.

A skipped Small/Big Blind does not grant its played-round reward, unused-hand payout, interest, end-of-round effects or following shop. A tag may separately grant money or a pack; “skip pays $0” does not describe every resulting balance. Skip events may also affect specific Jokers/tags. Skipping both ordinary Blinds avoids playing cards there but does not authorize assumptions about all other card history.

| Tag | Effect | Timing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Uncommon | Free Uncommon Joker | Next shop |
| Rare | Free Rare Joker | Next shop |
| Negative | Eligible base-edition shop Joker made Negative and free | Eligible next-shop offer |
| Foil | Eligible base-edition shop Joker made Foil and free | Eligible next-shop offer |
| Holographic | Eligible base-edition shop Joker made Holographic and free | Eligible next-shop offer |
| Polychrome | Eligible base-edition shop Joker made Polychrome and free | Eligible next-shop offer |
| Investment | $25 | After next Boss defeated |
| Voucher | Extra voucher | Next shop |
| Boss | Reroll Boss | On resolution |
| Standard | Mega Standard Pack | On resolution |
| Charm | Mega Arcana Pack | On resolution |
| Meteor | Mega Celestial Pack | On resolution |
| Buffoon | Mega Buffoon Pack | On resolution |
| Handy | $1 per hand played this run | On resolution |
| Garbage | $1 per unused discard counted this run | On resolution |
| Ethereal | Normal Spectral Pack | On resolution |
| Coupon | Initial shop cards/packs free, excluding vouchers | Next shop; not arbitrary rerolled stock |
| Double | Copy next eligible non-Double tag | Deferred |
| Juggle | +3 hand size | Next round |
| D6 | Starting reroll price $0 | Next shop |
| Top-up | Up to 2 Common Jokers, subject to room | On resolution |
| Speed | $5 per skipped Blind, including this skip | On resolution |
| Orbital | +3 levels to displayed hand | On resolution |
| Economy | Double money, gain capped at $40 | On resolution |

Multiple Double Tags add copies; do not model them as exponential doubling. A shop tag does not itself create immediate usable inventory or a new shop. Check the current queue, eligible offers and capacity as tags resolve; do not assume every queued effect can apply to the same offer.

Choose from the displayed tags. The guide does not specify exact minimum-Ante selection pools or future tag probabilities.

References: [Tags](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Tags), [1.0.1f developer patch notes](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/14234225/).
entries.guide/balatro-jokers:
# Evaluate the whole Joker engine

Read mechanics (read_rules key: guide/balatro-jokers/mechanics) for trigger phases and copying. Use current public effect text and counters for each Joker; the examples cover common interactions rather than every Joker.

Evaluate an effect by what it adds to realistic hands and future opportunities: Chips, additive Mult, multiplication, retriggers, income, consistency, rule changes or utility. Rarity and printed ceiling are insufficient. A support Joker's value includes the other effects it enables.

A scaler needs time and affordable activation. Compare its next-Blind output with the bridge it displaces, then its likely value before the revealed Boss. A static Joker need not be sold at an arbitrary Ante or contribution percentage; an Eternal commitment need not be worthless merely because it provides income.

Order by actual trigger phase, copy direction and dependencies. Simple independent additions often precede multipliers, but no global sort handles all copies, first-card effects and sacrifices. Copy-target changes between legal settled actions can serve different phases; do not assume an animation-time reorder exists.

Before buying or selling, evaluate stickers, Negative capacity, cash-linked scoring and Boss resilience. Preserve a dependency only while the actual alternatives justify it. One disabled Joker may matter more than several small score differences; redundancy costs a slot and is conditional on the revealed problem.

Choose an actual replacement or order, with an optional short note about the dependency changed. Re-observe afterward.
entries.guide/balatro-jokers/mechanics:
# Joker mechanics and trigger vocabulary

Use the current Joker text and dynamic counters to identify its trigger, value and compatible copy targets.

| Wording / role | Relevant event |
| --- | --- |
| Blind selected / start of round | Selection/start resource change |
| Before scoring / when hand played | Pre-scoring hook; exact wording and implementation matter |
| Each scored card / when scored | Per-card scoring hook |
| Held in hand | Held-card scoring or round-end hook as specified |
| Independent +Chips, +Mult, ×Mult; contains/is a hand | Joker's independent scoring contribution unless effect says otherwise |
| Gains / loses / resets | Value changes at the named event, contributes at its own scoring phase |
| Retrigger | Eligible additional scored/held card activation |
| Discarded / sold / destroyed / reroll / pack skip / round end | Named event; do not substitute another event because cards leave the same area |

Blueprint copies the immediately right-hand Joker's compatible ability. Brainstorm copies the leftmost Joker's compatible ability; **it does not search rightward for the first compatible Joker**. A missing or incompatible target does not authorize another target. Editions/stickers are not copied as abilities, and copying current scaler output does not generally duplicate its permanent growth. Multi-copy/cycle behavior requires matching evidence.

During the independent pass, Foil/Holographic precedes the Joker's own ability and Polychrome follows it. Per-card Jokers act during card events regardless of row position relative to independent +Mult. Other-Joker hooks can complicate a simple sort.

In this rules baseline, Hanging Chad retriggers the first scoring card twice. Photograph gives ×2 on the first scoring face card and its eligible retriggers. If that first scorer is a valid face and both effects apply, three activations contribute ×8 to Mult available at those events. Later independent +Mult is not multiplied retroactively. Face debuffs and actual first-scorer identity matter.

Vampire may remove an enhancement before its scoring contribution; use the resulting state rather than awarding the removed Glass/Bonus/etc. effect as well.

References: [Blueprint](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Blueprint), [Brainstorm](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Brainstorm), [Hanging Chad](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Hanging_Chad), [Photograph](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Photograph), [Vampire](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Vampire), [Activation Sequence](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Guide%3A_Activation_Sequence).
entries.guide/balatro-orchestrator:
# Route the current question

Play to complete the ordinary Ante-8 native run. Use current public state, active effects and the host's actual tool schemas. When a handbook default differs from the observed game, use the observed value; keep missing information unknown.

For a rule or numeric value, read the relevant mechanics reference. For an action choice, load its decision skill and only the references needed. Do not load the whole guide each turn.

| Need | Neutral rules/reference | Decision skill |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Phase, counters, terminology | Core rules (read_rules key: guide/balatro-core-rules) | This router |
| Hand recognition and timing | Scoring rules (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/mechanics) | Scoring (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring) |
| Play or discard | Scoring rules above | Play/discard (read_rules key: guide/balatro-play-discard) |
| Joker effects, copies, ordering | Joker mechanics (read_rules key: guide/balatro-jokers/mechanics) | Jokers (read_rules key: guide/balatro-jokers) |
| Prices, packs, vouchers, tags | Shop rules (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/shop), tags (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop/tags) | Economy/shop (read_rules key: guide/balatro-economy-shop) |
| Tarot, Planet, Spectral | Consumable catalog (read_rules key: guide/balatro-consumables/catalog) | Consumables (read_rules key: guide/balatro-consumables) |
| Enhancements, editions, seals | Modifiers (read_rules key: guide/balatro-deck-building/modifiers) | Deck building (read_rules key: guide/balatro-deck-building) |
| Revealed Boss effect | Boss catalog (read_rules key: guide/balatro-boss-blinds/bosses) | Boss preparation (read_rules key: guide/balatro-boss-blinds) |
| Deck/stake modifiers | Decks and stakes (read_rules key: guide/balatro-decks-stakes/decks-stakes) | Adaptation (read_rules key: guide/balatro-decks-stakes) |
| Build direction or investment | No additional mechanics required | Run strategy (read_rules key: guide/balatro-run-strategy) |
| Unclear result or action semantics | Harness mapping (read_rules key: guide/balatro-orchestrator/harness) | Validation (read_rules key: guide/balatro-validation) |

Read the current settled public state, choose one supported action, and re-observe after mutation. A short optional decision note can identify the decisive tradeoff or uncertainty; do not require a step-by-step reasoning transcript or add fields absent from the active schema. Public IDs do not reveal hidden ranks, deck order, RNG, or future outcomes.

Read harness tools (read_rules key: guide/balatro-orchestrator/harness) for supported operations and known limits (read_rules key: guide/limits) when an unresolved mechanic affects the decision.
entries.guide/balatro-orchestrator/harness:
# Balatro Horizons tools

The `tools_v2` interface offers named tools for the current phase. Use their current schemas, observation ID, visible object IDs and selection limits. Submit one game action, then use the returned settled state before making a dependent choice.

| Tool | Purpose | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inspect_state` | Retrieve more current public details | Masked state sections only; no hidden identities, seed, RNG or future state |
| `read_history` | Retrieve earlier public events | Bounded pagination of public history |
| `read_skill(name)` | Read one available Balatro skill | Names come from the supplied catalog; follow `next_key` with `read_rules` for another page |
| `read_rules(key)` | Read a frozen rule entry | `index` lists keys; exact keys and registered aliases resolve entries |
| `calculate(expression)` | Evaluate arithmetic | Numeric literals, unary signs, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and modulo |
| Phase-specific actions, including `play_hand`, `discard`, `buy`, `select_blind` | Advance the game | Only actions and targets offered by the current phase are available |

Rules and skill lookup read the run's frozen dictionary. In guide-enabled runs, `guide` and `guide/index` open the router; a module uses a key such as `guide/balatro-scoring`, and its mechanics reference uses `guide/balatro-scoring/mechanics`. `guide/limits` and `guide/sources` open the shared references. Use `index` to discover the keys currently available. Lookup does not search arbitrary files or web pages. A rule entry's descriptive text may not specify every timing interaction. Arithmetic is not hand recognition or a scoring simulation; function calls, exponentiation and combinations are not accepted by `calculate`. Translate a supported expression into the actual arithmetic syntax rather than sending mathematical notation unchanged.

A hand-type display and base Chips/Mult are not a full score preview. Estimate scoring from the public cards, effects, order and counters, and label uncertainty when a needed hook is unknown.

Physical card/Joker order, selection order and the order of IDs in a note can differ. Use the supported reorder semantics and re-observe before a dependent play or Death use. Duplicate cards have distinct IDs; an opaque ID does not reveal a concealed card. Null or absent fields mean unknown, not zero or a default.

Optional decision notes and bounded memory belong only in fields supported by the active tool schema. A concise note can state the decisive tradeoff or uncertainty; a step-by-step reasoning transcript is not required. Revalidate remembered plans against each new state.

Helpers leave the game unchanged and remain subject to the current decision's call and context limits. A rejected action does not authorize changing its targets silently. If execution status is unresolved after a timeout, Horizons ends the episode as an infrastructure failure; the player must not retry a possibly executed action.

The initial context supplies skill names and short descriptions. Read only the needed skill or reference. Pages carry `complete` and `next_key`; follow the latter through `read_rules` when needed. A `REFERENCE_CONTEXT_LIMIT` result means no additional page fits this decision. Existing context is retained. Skill text lasts for the current decision; save concise reminders or chapter keys in explicit memory if needed after the next action. The older `operate_v1` interface uses a `rules` operation with the same `guide/...` keys.
entries.guide/balatro-play-discard:
# Choose a play or discard

Choose for the actual target and remaining resources. Treat estimated draw odds separately from the probability of surviving the whole Blind.

Find a currently available reliable clear as a baseline. Compare relevant alternatives: another supported hand family, a smaller play retaining useful held cards, a cycling play, a consumable-assisted line, or a discard toward attainable outs. Use scoring (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring) when needed.

Compare survival across the remaining hands, not only the next hand's mean. `remaining_target / hands_left` is orientation, not proof of viability. One hand left is a reason to optimize the final play; it is not a reason to stop using available discards or consumables. A made hand can be discarded when it cannot clear and a better draw is the only viable continuation.

Keep held Steel/Gold/Blue value and Purple discard value distinct. Kicker cards can cycle the hand or satisfy The Psychic, but may change classification, lose held value, or incur played-card penalties. Check the revealed Boss and available draw count before every decision. Growth or income farming is an option only when its survival cost is justified; the round can end before another planned hand.

When the public remaining multiset is known and draws are uniform without replacement, `P(at least one useful out in d draws) = 1 - C(N-K,d)/C(N,d)`. Expected useful count is `d*K/N`. Require `0 <= K <= N` and `0 <= d <= N`; these are draw probabilities, not complete hand/Blind survival probabilities. For `N=44,K=9,d=3`, the first expression is about 0.5058. Unknown composition requires an estimate, not invented precision. No hidden order or seed reconstruction is permitted.

For Straights, preserve viable rank windows; for Flushes, compare useful suit density and card effects; for repeated ranks, seek the supported rank. Refresh those counts after deck edits. Submit one supported action with actual IDs and observe again; optional notes can state the main risk.
entries.guide/balatro-run-strategy:
# Maintain a contingent run plan

Plan around attainable hands and visible opportunities. Assess progress against upcoming targets and Boss effects rather than a fixed Joker milestone for each Ante.

Early: obtain a scoring floor from available hands and affordable offers; take income or scaling when the next Blind remains viable. Middle: connect repeatable hand families, Chips, early Mult, multiplication, consistency and growth to the revealed Boss. Late: spend on a reliable finish when investment has too little time to repay, accounting for cash-dependent score and reserved Boss-control fees.

| Engine family | Development opportunity | Fragility to inspect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| High Card/Pair | Easy-to-form hands; independent/held effects | Insufficient base growth or dependence on one effect |
| Flush | Suit consolidation and scored-card synergies | Suit debuffs and limited future scaling |
| Straight | Planet growth and preserved rank windows | Gaps and fragile completion paths |
| Repeated rank / secret hands | Copies of strong cards | Draw density and an accidental hand-level pivot |
| Retriggers | Repeated valuable card events | Wrong first scorer, debuffs, phase confusion |
| Held-card engine | Small plays retaining support | Hand-size loss, forced cards/discards and debuffs |
| Plasma | Grow effective Chips plus Mult | Applying ordinary product-balancing advice |

These overlap. Commit based on real support and attainable draws; pivot when the transition cost is covered. Levels and money already spent are not reasons to persist with a failing plan, but an unsupported attractive card is not sufficient reason to abandon a working engine.

Use three planning horizons: **immediate = survive this Blind; short = survive this Ante; long = survive this run**. Compare a choice across these horizons when it trades present strength for development. Complete the native run; reaching a later Ante alone does not satisfy the win objective.

Keep only a compact optional memory of hand family, bottleneck, next useful acquisition class, income/growth, revealed Boss interaction and pivot conditions. It contains public facts and conditional intentions, not future outcomes. A reliable clear is valuable; growth farming can trade present resources for later survival when the remaining draw paths and Boss restrictions justify the risk.
entries.guide/balatro-scoring:
# Estimate a candidate score

Use mechanics (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/mechanics) for phase order, hand precedence and examples; load hand values (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/hand-values) only when a base value or increment is needed.

Establish selected cards in physical order, held cards, current hand values, active Boss, Joker effects/counters/order and copy targets. First classify the hand and scoring subset. Then apply known pre-scoring changes, scored-card events/retriggers, held effects, independent Jokers, and final modifiers in their actual phases.

Compare with `max(0, target - accumulated_score)`. Keep money, growth and permanent card changes separate from this score. A hand label/base Chips-and-Mult display is not a complete deterministic preview, and the current arithmetic helper is not a scorer.

Use **exact arithmetic under stated assumptions**, **justified bound**, **estimate**, or **unknown** accurately. Missing hooks, hidden identities, RNG or unverified rounding prevent a native-exact claim. A no-luck case is a lower bound only if all omitted outcomes and interactions can only improve it.

For ordering, compare meaningful alternatives within controllable timing. Additive Mult before multiplicative Mult helps in a simple same-phase case; first-card retriggers, copying and destructive effects can change the best order. Reorder through the host's actual action and re-observe before playing. Optionally report the score assumption and one decisive difference; a full internal reasoning trace is not required.
entries.guide/balatro-scoring/hand-values:
# Hand recognition and level values

Rules baseline: Balatro 1.0.1. Use observed hand values when levels or active effects change these defaults.[^hands][^planets][^patch]

## Recognition, highest priority first

Flush Five; Flush House; Five of a Kind; Straight Flush; Four of a Kind; Full House; Flush; Straight; Three of a Kind; Two Pair; Pair; High Card. Royal Flush is the Ace-high Straight Flush label, not a separate hand-level track.[^hands]

| Hand | Rank/suit pattern without rule-changing Jokers | Level-1 Chips | Level-1 Mult | Chips per level | Mult per level | Planet |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| High Card | No higher category; highest rank scores | 5 | 1 | 10 | 1 | Pluto |
| Pair | Two matching ranks | 10 | 2 | 15 | 1 | Mercury |
| Two Pair | Two different rank pairs | 20 | 2 | 20 | 1 | Uranus |
| Three of a Kind | Three matching ranks | 30 | 3 | 20 | 2 | Venus |
| Straight | Five consecutive distinct ranks | 30 | 4 | 30 | 3 | Saturn |
| Flush | Five cards of one suit | 35 | 4 | 15 | 2 | Jupiter |
| Full House | Three of one rank plus two of another | 40 | 4 | 25 | 2 | Earth |
| Four of a Kind | Four matching ranks | 60 | 7 | 30 | 3 | Mars |
| Straight Flush | Both Straight and Flush | 100 | 8 | 40 | 4 | Neptune |
| Five of a Kind | Five matching ranks | 120 | 12 | 35 | 3 | Planet X |
| Flush House | Both Full House and Flush | 140 | 14 | 40 | 4 | Ceres |
| Flush Five | Both Five of a Kind and Flush | 160 | 16 | 50 | 3 | Eris |

Without additional base-value changes, `C(L)=C(1)+(L-1)*delta_C` and `M(L)=M(1)+(L-1)*delta_M`. Royal Flush uses Neptune and Straight Flush values. Secret Planets become eligible in ordinary generation after their hand has been played in that run; Black Hole can upgrade those hands before they are revealed.[^planets]

## Recognition cautions

An Ace may be low in `A,2,3,4,5` or high in `10,J,Q,K,A`; a Straight cannot wrap through `Q,K,A,2,3`. Suits do not break score ties. Aces are not face cards. For a Pair or Four of a Kind, unused kickers are played but normally do not score. A Full House can satisfy a Joker that asks whether a Pair is contained; do not equate every "contains" condition with the final hand label. Four identical ranks do not form Two Pair, which needs two different ranks.[^hands]

Stone ignores its underlying rank/suit for hand formation and is an extra scoring card when played, unless debuffed. Wild changes suit membership, not rank. Do not use Wild as an arbitrary missing Straight rank.[^mods]

Four Fingers reduces Straight/Flush requirements to four. A five-card set can contain a four-card Straight and a different four-card Flush and classify as Straight Flush. Example: `3S,4S,5H,6S,KS`; the Straight uses 3–6 and the Flush uses 3S,4S,6S,KS. Do not replace the game's classifier with a conventional five-card poker library for this case.[^four]

Shortcut permits gaps of one missing rank between consecutive selected ranks, still without Ace wrapping. Other rule-changing effects must be read from the active state. Do not extend a baseline classifier to unknown mods by guesswork.[^shortcut]

## Arithmetic checks

Level-2 Pair has 25 base Chips and 3 base Mult. Two plain Aces therefore score `(25+22)*3 = 141`. A level-1 Flush `AS,JS,9S,6S,2S` scores `(35+11+10+9+6+2)*4 = 292` without other effects; merely making a Flush does not guarantee clearing an Ante-1 Small Blind of 300.


## Sources

[^hands]: [Balatro Wiki: Poker Hands](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Poker_Hands). Classification, scoring subsets and hand precedence.

[^planets]: [Balatro Wiki: Planet Cards](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Planet_Cards). Planet mapping, level increments and secret hand eligibility.

[^patch]: [LocalThunk: Balatro 1.0.1f patch notes, May 1, 2024 (SteamDB mirror)](https://steamdb.info/patchnotes/14234225/). Developer-authored historical patch notes mirrored by SteamDB. Baseline changes, not proof of the latest installed build.

[^mods]: [Balatro Wiki: Card Modifiers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Card_Modifiers). Enhancement, edition and seal layers; debuffs.

[^four]: [Balatro Wiki: Four Fingers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Four_Fingers). Four-card requirements and overlapping-subset Straight Flushes.

[^shortcut]: [Balatro Wiki: Shortcut](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Shortcut). One-rank gaps, with no wrapping around an Ace.
entries.guide/balatro-scoring/mechanics:
# Scoring mechanics reference

Use this phase model to organize score estimates. For uncommon hooks or close rounding thresholds, consult known limits (read_rules key: guide/limits).

## Recognition and scoring subset

Read hand values (read_rules key: guide/balatro-scoring/hand-values) for the 12-hand/Planet table, precedence, levels and Four Fingers example. The game classifies the highest recognized category, not the hand with the most valuable current level. Royal Flush uses the Straight Flush track. “Contains Pair” can differ from “is Pair.”

Plain scored cards add their rank for 2–10, 10 for J/Q/K and 11 for Ace. Only the recognized scoring subset normally contributes; played kickers do not become discard events. Stone and Splash can add scoring cards. Debuffed cards can still participate in classification while contributing no ordinary card effects. Wild loses all-suit behavior when debuffed; Stone's detailed debuff/identity interaction is a matching-build edge case.

## Abbreviated event order

| Phase | Events to model | Material limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boss / pre-scoring | Restrictions, hand-level changes, hand-play hooks, enhancement changes | Relative hooks can matter; do not infer a complete ordering from this table |
| Scored cards, physical left to right | Rank chips, enhancement/edition/seal effects, eligible per-card Jokers and retriggers | Retriggers repeat eligible card events, not the hand base or whole independent Joker pass |
| Held cards | Steel, relevant held-card Jokers and eligible repeats | Played and held roles differ |
| Independent Jokers, left to right | Foil/Holographic before own independent effect; Polychrome after; Joker-dependent hooks/copies | Copies and other-Joker hooks can intervene |
| Final effects | Observatory for matching held Planets; deck finalization; score added to round | Exact rounding and uncommon interactions require engine evidence |
| Later events | After-hand effects, destruction and round-end triggers as applicable | Not a claim of exact mutual ordering or cash-out timing |

Glass/card Polychrome/Steel and per-card multiplication occur before independent-Joker additions. Moving an independent Joker left cannot move it into the card phase. Separate retrigger sources add extra activations: initial 1 + Red Seal 1 + two additional repeats = 4 activations, not 6.

Do not conflate a scaling value change with when that value contributes score. A Joker can hook several phases. “When discarded,” “when sold,” “when a card is destroyed,” “when rerolling,” and “at end of round” are separate events; read each effect. Red Seal does not automatically repeat every possible event.

## Arithmetic examples, conditional on stated effects

- Pair of Kings, base 10 Chips/2 Mult: total Chips 30. Synthetic independent +4 then ×1.5 gives 270; reversing gives 210.
- Pair of 9s, one Mult then one Glass, independent +10: `(10+9+9)*((2+4)*2+10)=616`. Glass first gives 504.
- Four 10s, base 60/7, one Foil, held Steel King, independent +20: `150*(7*1.5+20)=4575`. These assumptions exclude all other effects.
- Lone Mult-enhanced Red-sealed Ace: one extra eligible scoring activation gives `(5+11+11)*(1+4+4)=243`.
- Flush level 4, card chips 34: `(80+34)*10=1140`. Poker rank alone is not a score forecast.

For fixed nonnegative addition `a` and multiplier `x>1`, same-phase addition first improves Mult by `a*(x-1)`. This algebra does not establish the best arrangement when first-card selection or copies change which effects occur.

Ordinary score is Chips × Mult with engine rounding. Plasma balances Chips and Mult from their sum before scoring, approximately `((C+M)/2)^2`. Exact flooring for odd or fractional sums remains unresolved. For example, sum 110 gives 3025 under either common rounding interpretation, while sum 111 depends on where flooring occurs. Compare gains to the effective sum; adding to the lower component is not inherently better.

References: [Poker Hands](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Poker_Hands), [Activation Sequence](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Guide%3A_Activation_Sequence), [Card Modifiers](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Card_Modifiers), [Plasma Deck](https://balatrogame.fandom.com/wiki/Plasma_Deck).
entries.guide/balatro-validation:
# Check the relevant discrepancy

Check the smallest set of public facts needed to explain the discrepancy.

For an action mismatch, check the current observation, phase, offered tool schema, IDs, target count/position, forced selection, resources, capacity and permissions. Distinguish a protocol rejection from a legal submission that scores zero. In Horizons, unresolved execution after a timeout ends the episode as an infrastructure failure; the playing model must not retry a possibly executed action. Operator reconciliation belongs outside the playing policy.

For a score mismatch, inspect classification, level/base values, scoring subset, debuffs, pre-scoring changes, card events/retriggers, held effects, independent Jokers/editions/copies, final deck rule and rounding. A random outcome alone does not establish a rule change. Correct arithmetic on an incorrect phase model is still a modeling error.

Label each relevant conclusion supported, contradicted or unresolved. Use harness tools (read_rules key: guide/balatro-orchestrator/harness) to retrieve available public evidence and rules. Keep an estimate uncertain when the necessary scoring detail is unavailable.

If the available public evidence cannot resolve a mechanic, use a conservative estimate or a different supported line. Consult known limits (read_rules key: guide/limits) for the specific gaps; keep unseen outcomes and private setup information out of the decision.
entries.guide/limits:
# Known mechanics limits

Use current public values and effects whenever they resolve a question. When an interaction below determines whether a line survives, avoid calling the estimate exact; seek the relevant public rule or state, retain a margin, or compare an alternative line.

| Area | Unresolved detail | Operational guidance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plasma finalization | Exact flooring for odd or fractional Chips-plus-Mult sums | The effective sum drives balanced scoring. At a close threshold, do not assume that squaring the average and flooring each balanced component are interchangeable. |
| Interest settlement | Eligible balance after Gold, Rental, Joker income and other round-end effects; ordering relative to awards | Use the $1-per-$5 rule and actual cap for orientation, but do not count unreceived money or assign an exact settlement total without the relevant event ordering. |
| Complex scoring hooks | Fine-grained ordering of pre-scoring mutations, Joker-dependent effects, copies and retriggers | Track the relevant phases and actual effects. An arithmetic result is exact only under its stated model; it is not an engine preview. |
| Debuffed identities and triggers | Some Stone/Wild interactions and unusual played-set, held or discard hooks | Separate hand classification from scoring eligibility. Use current debuffs and the relevant effect text; do not assume that a debuff prevents every whole-hand check. |
| Joker creation and destruction | Capacity exceptions, Negative copies, Eternal survivors, copy chains and simultaneous destruction | Check current eligible targets, slots and possible survivors before Ankh, Hex or another destructive effect. Re-observe before a dependent action. |
| Boss transitions | Target changes after disabling Wall/Violet/Needle; Cerulean reselection timing, Serpent capacity edges and Flint rounding | Observe the resulting target, forced selection, hand and counters. Do not precommit a second action using an assumed transition. |
| Perishable and combined stickers | Timer pauses and eligibility of some sticker combinations | Use the displayed remaining counter and actual sell/destroy permissions. Account for Rental separately from whether the scoring ability is active. |
| Random offers and selection pools | Exact shop/pack distributions, minimum-Ante pools and Boss repetition rules | Evaluate visible offers and tags. Do not build a precise acquisition probability or a guaranteed next Boss from this guide. |

The guide summarizes common effects rather than cataloging every Joker, challenge or mod. For unlisted content, retrieve the actual effect. The current tools provide public state, history, frozen rules and restricted arithmetic; they do not provide a scoring simulator or hidden-state prediction.
